doc.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Learning to read changes; going on the road with Bobby Hackett to Hyannis
summary: After about a year and a half he learned chord symbols and joined Bobby Hackett at a Hyannis resort.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: I had a good ear. I mean I knew whether a chord was a minor chord or a major chord without having to be told but it was at this point that I started getting into the text and was learning to read and figuring out changes, learning what chord symbols, what they really meant and what all that fruit salad, you know the plus eleven and all that stuff hanging off, dangling off the end of a chord meant and what to do with it. And I stayed there about a year and a half and Bobby Hackett asked me to come on the road with him to a place named Dunfy’s. Dunfy’s Hyannis Resort which we immediately named Dummy’s High Handed Resort. It was run by a bunch of gangsters at the time.
